summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback program. The company bought back 1,643,392 ordinary shares over five sessions (June 1-5, 2026) for a volume-weighted average price ranging from 1,824.85 GBp to 1,922.23 GBp, through broker Citigroup Global Markets Limited. Shares are held as treasury, increasing treasury holdings to 6.61% of voting rights. Since the program began on May 11, 2026, 6,233,812 shares have been purchased. No explicit program size or expiration was disclosed. This is a standard, ongoing capital return activity, not a material special situation. Watch for future buyback pace or completion announcements; no risk-arb angle.
